summary: Independently verified the .1R.12 Gate-6 Permission Broker production-consumption integration (run_gate6_permission_broker). RE-DERIVE, DO NOT TRUST: every Gate-6 requirement re-derived from PBRD-001 v2.0 (section 4 fact 14, section 5, section 7, section 9, section 10, section 12, section 15), RDGO-001 v3.0 section 7, PBPA-001, POL-005 (source permission_broker_foundation.ExecutionDisabledRule), RIHAC-001 v2.0 section 16, RIASC-001 v3.0, HPAC-001 v2.0, RPAC-001 v1.0 and current source -- not from the .1R.12 report, its tests, or symbol names. No defect repair; no src/ change (git diff --name-only e04ca7af HEAD -- src/pcae is empty). VERDICT: VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS -- GATE-6 PERMISSION BROKER PRODUCTION CONSUMPTION INTEGRATION COMPLETE; GATE-6 -- CLOSED at the PB production-consumption boundary for runtime_dispatch. Independently confirmed: run_gate6_permission_broker is the SOLE production Gate-6 owner and the only production caller of the .1R.7 trusted builder build_runtime_dispatch_permission_broker_request (git grep inventory; the generic build_permission_broker_request raises ValueError for any runtime_dispatch action or context -- no parallel authority path; six other production PB-evaluator callers use the generic builder with non-runtime_dispatch action types). Gate5Result provenance is identity-registry membership only (behavioral tests -- None, object.__new__, full field reconstruction, copy/deepcopy (raise TypeError), duck-typed .projection/.invocation_id, bare validated=true, str, int all fail closed with ('gate6_untrusted_gate5_result',) and _GATE6_DECISIONS stays empty). Exact invocation binding is enforced twice: gate5_result.invocation_id == identity.invocation_id in run_gate6, plus the builder's _expected_subject_scope_binding_digest(identity, inputs) recomputation and equality check. The request is built ONLY through the trusted builder (AST of run_gate6: no PermissionBrokerRequest(...) construction, no _build_runtime_dispatch_permission_broker_request call); an untrusted ValidatedAuthorityProjection past the provenance gate is rejected inside the builder (gate6_request_construction_failed:untrusted_validated_authority_projection). The byte-unmodified canonical permission_broker_foundation.PermissionBroker evaluator is called EXACTLY ONCE (runtime counter wrapper) and run_gate6 replicates no policy / POL / precedence / reason-chain logic (AST asserts it calls none of _compose / evaluate_all / PolicyResult / PolicyRegistry / ExecutionDisabledRule / MissingHumanApprovalRule / ReasonChainLink / _decision). DENY > HUMAN_REVIEW > ALLOW re-derived directly from _compose (loop over (DECISION_DENY, DECISION_HUMAN_REVIEW) before the trailing DECISION_ALLOW; empty results -> fail-closed DECISION_DENY). POL-005 hard-DENYs every simulation_only=False request unconditionally (reads no approval / authority / human field) and is NOT overridable by would-be validated human authority (ExecutionDisabledRule().evaluate on a request with approval_present forced True still returns DENY / NG-025). Gate6Decision is ephemeral, non-serializable (__reduce__ raises), identity-only (eq/hash id-based), not subclassable, process-local-registry-provenanced -- not transferable authority; a PB ALLOW stays 'policy would allow if execution existed', never runtime capability, never execution. No Gate-7 (Runtime Enforcement) / Gate-8 (Shell Gate) / Gate-9 (0 proof consumption, 0 approval consumption, 0 consumption records, no consumption.json anywhere) / Gate-10 (no adapter / subprocess / provider / network / credential / hardware) path exists -- AST forbidden-import scan passes; the Gate-6 path also imports nothing from hpac_lifecycle / hpac_verifier and contains no PROOF_VERIFIED_AND_BOUND / sequence3 reference. Runtime stays not_implemented / Observed / observe / unavailable, re-asserted after Gate-6 rejections and after a Gate-6 envelope run. NON-REAL isolation reconfirmed: validate_approval hard-stops non-PRODUCTION assurance, run_gate5 never returns a Gate5Result on any obtainable path, so is_gate5_result is never true for a real object and no positive production Gate-6 evaluation is reachable. To close the .1R.12 runtime-coverage gap (no .1R.12 test drives Gate-6 steps 2->5 at runtime -- the NON-REAL hard stop makes a real Gate5Result unobtainable, so .1R.12 covers the step-2/3/4 guards only by source-substring / AST assertions), the .1R.13 suite installs a CLEARLY-LABELLED test-boundary substitution of the is_gate5_result predicate ONLY (the check a real FIDO2/UI ceremony would satisfy), keeping projection = None / untrusted throughout so NO authority is manufactured and NO ALLOW is ever produced -- the deepest reachable outcomes are POL-005 DENY (real request) and POL-004 HUMAN_REVIEW (simulation). Positive production Gate-6 authority remains unreachable; no synthetic REAL authentication result was fabricated. V-4 adjudication: NON-BLOCKING CONTRACT-ALIGNMENT DEBT. PBRD-001 v2.0 section 4 fact 14's literal 7-field human_authority_binding (approval_id, approval_digest, authority_projection_id, authority_projection_digest, authority_contract_version const RIHAC-001/2.0, proof_validation_digest, request_binding_digest) vs the frozen 3-field production RuntimeDispatchHumanAuthorityBinding (approval_id, approval_record_digest, validation_evidence_digest) is a LOSSLESS digest-collapse: validation_evidence_digest = ValidatedAuthorityProjection.evidence_digest() = SHA-256 over the full 14-key projection binding payload, which cryptographically commits to the projection content (authority_projection_digest), proof_id + provenance/freshness/expiry/consumption verdicts + mechanism_assurance (proof_validation_digest), subject_scope_binding_digest + invocation_id (request_binding_digest), and schema_version (authority_contract_version); authority_projection_id is enforced MORE strongly by exact-object _VALIDATED_AUTHORITY_CONTEXTS registry membership; authority_contract_version is a zero-entropy constant; request_binding_digest is additionally re-checked by recomputation in project_human_authority_binding and by the invocation-id guard in run_gate6. Collision analysis (the decisive test, prompt section 15): two authority contexts the contract can distinguish necessarily differ in at least one projection payload key, hence in evidence_digest(), hence in the 3-field binding -- NO lost authority semantics, NO collision (test-proven for proof_id and subject_scope_binding_digest changes). .1R.9 section 25 froze this slice as 'no change to the 14-fact shape'; PBRD-001 is byte-unchanged; the divergence is contract-text staleness, not a Gate-6 defect. Recommend a dedicated contract-clarification phase to either document the 3-field digest-collapsed form as normative or require the production binding to carry all 7 named subfields. V-2 / V-3 carried non-blocking with NO Gate-6 impact and NO amplification -- the Gate-6 path never reads, creates, or depends on the HPAC lifecycle sequence-3 event or the disputed 'which gate creates it' wording; authority derives from gate5_result.projection (validate_approval steps 4/12: approval reference + RIHAC v2.0 projection digest), re-trusted at point of use.
